metadata.title: Retro Sepia Portrait with Vertical Sidebar

recipe.visualDefinition: A warm, sepia-toned portrait of a woman with voluminous 80s-style hair and heavy jewelry, framed by a solid black vertical sidebar on the left containing stylized, rotated typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast relationship between the black sidebar and the golden-yellow photo
Vertical alignment of text mirroring the upright posture of the subject
Textural contrast between the smooth skin tones and the busy, metallic jewelry and hair
Warm monochromatic color palette unifying the photographic element
coreInvariants: Solid black vertical bar on the left edge

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the remaining square space to the right of the sidebar, medium shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, framed by hands and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold vertical text on the left, moves right to the subject's face, then down through the layered jewelry.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The black sidebar acts as a structural negative space, while the blurred background provides depth.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale Pink (small geometric accents in typography)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, high warmth; high value contrast between the sidebar and the glowing skin tones.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to amber, black, white, and one soft accent color

letterConstructionRules: Vertically stacked and rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise
Inclusion of small geometric shapes (rectangles/dots) as decorative accents
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lowercase 'i' with a large circular dot
Geometric, almost architectural construction of 'A' and 'E'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family with varying case and geometric accents.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong geometric 70s/80s feel with similar 'A' and 'G' structures.
Classic geometric proportions and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned, grainy portrait of a woman with big 80s hair and lots of jewelry, leaving the left 20% of the frame as a solid black vertical bar.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, white geometric sans-serif text inside the black bar, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise, with small pink rectangular accents at the ends of words.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly amber/sepia and black?
Is there a visible film grain texture?
Is the sidebar a solid, clean black?

adjustableVariables: Color of the small geometric accents
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not bleed into the photographic area
Check that the sepia tone is consistent across the image
Verify that the grain is uniform and not blotchy
Confirm the vertical text is legible despite the rotation
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned grainy portrait with a high-contrast vertical sidebar for a classic retro-editorial layout.
